programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: Based on their "intelligent luxury" and "waste to wealth" philosophies, Soneva Fushi in the Maldives offers incredible insight into how environmental sensitivity doesn't preclude luxury. Eco-Centro is the heart of the resort, turning waste into recycled products. Soneva Fushi has its own recycled glass studio and celestial observatory but this is slightly overshadowed by the 60,000 sqft, Villa #11

programme.title: The Wine Guys: Grape Escapes
programme.desc: Michael and Charlie travel to San Silvestro in Piedmont, Italy. We learn about the importance of rich carbonate soil and aging in large barrels to produce top quality Barolo wines. At a favourite local restaurant the Wine Guys marvel at the custom of pouring wine over top of ravioli.

programme.title: Great Destinations Americas
programme.sub-title: Great Destinations Americas: Across The USA
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.
